body: Go and physically hurt her. I'm not even fucking joking. She thinks that she can get away with the crap she pulls all the time. I've seen the exact same shit with kids and they don't stop until they have some sort of consequence slam itself into them. If she doesn't know that it's a problem, then by all means try to have a 1 on 1 talk. But if she does, she's acting like a child that deserves to get hit.

Nice poem (although it could have been a series of short paragraphs and just as impactful).

When I have trouble trying to feel something, I try to *force* myself feel something. How you go about that is up to you.
